The C++ excerpts are diagnosis, not a runnable app, so asking for a Fiddle is useful; proceeding with the precise source-level regression evidence is also defensible. printToPDF is explicitly a working comparison. Earlier tiny-output DPI and single-page PDF truncation reports have different behavior. Chromium constants used by Electron do not by themselves justify an upstream redirect.
